name: Bolt
summary: StackBlitz's prompt-to-app builder for websites and web apps.
description: Bolt, from StackBlitz, lets users build, run and deploy websites and web apps by describing them in plain language, entirely in the browser. Its differentiator is a full in-browser development environment, so generated code runs instantly without local setup. A free-forever plan is available to get started, and paid plans increase token allowances and add team features.
